integrity: Finite executable checks corroborate but do not prove the unrestricted theorem. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Classification is relative to finite uniform-alphabet Hamming graphs H(d,q), d>=1 and q>=2, in pure adjacency with no counting quantifiers.
Defining width is relative to the Hamming family, not the class of all finite graphs.
No optimal quantifier-rank or formula-size bound is asserted.
Historical-priority comparison is qualified by the possibility of a broader Cartesian-product composition theorem.
The dimension-two case is already covered by a prior rectangular rook-graph classification; no novelty is claimed for that case.
title: Sharp counting-free finite-variable theories of Hamming graphs
